description:
pkix-ct/src/log_list.rs:80-87 — insert() uses BTreeMap::insert and discards the returned Option<CtLog>. The docstring says 'Inserting a log with a log_id already present overwrites the previous entry' but the caller cannot tell whether their insert was an add or an overwrite.

Why this matters: a caller loading a log list incrementally (e.g., merging multiple sources: Google's list + Apple's list + a local addition) wants to detect duplicate log_ids — possibly with conflicting descriptions or different usable_from_ms windows. Silent overwrite means whichever source loads last wins, with no warning.

Suggested fix: change insert signature to return Result<Option<CtLog>> — Ok(Some(prev_log)) for overwrite, Ok(None) for new insert, Err for consistency-check failure. Pre-1.0 this is a free fix; post-1.0 it becomes a wrapping addition (insert_or_replace + try_insert).

Alternatively: add a try_insert() that returns Err if the log_id is already present, leaving insert() as the overwriting variant with the new return value.
title: CtLogList::insert overwrites existing entries silently, no signal to caller
